K01 N12 (LOW): `safeId` (register.tsx ~266) maps a session id to a file key by replacing characters outside `[A-Za-z0-9_-]` with `_` and truncating to 80, so two distinct ids can share one outbox file and one `$.store` key. Make the mapping injective while keeping every ordinary key unchanged (no migration):

K02 Rule (designed by the coordinator on claude-opus-5-5): if the id matches `/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}$/` the key is the id itself (UUID-shaped Claude Code session ids keep their existing file names). Otherwise the key is `<prefix>~<h>`, where `<prefix>` is the id with every character outside `[A-Za-z0-9_-]` replaced by `_`, cut to 56 characters (it may be empty), and `<h>` is a 16-hex-character hash of the WHOLE original id. Keys of the first form never contain `~`, so the two forms cannot collide with each other; two different ids of the second form collide only if their 64-bit hashes collide. The key is at most 73 characters. The empty id takes the second form (`~<h>`), which also removes the old `'unknown'` collision between an empty id and an id literally named `unknown`.

K03 The hash must be synchronous (safeId is called in synchronous paths): two 32-bit FNV-1a passes over the UTF-16 code units of the id, using `Math.imul(h ^ code, 16777619) >>> 0`, the first with offset basis 2166136261 (0x811c9dc5), the second with the same algorithm over the id prefixed by one NUL character, each rendered as 8 lower-case hex digits and concatenated (16 hex). Put it in a small pure helper next to `safeId`. No `crypto.subtle`, no BigInt.

K04 Keep every caller as it is (`generationPath`, the `$.store` key `outbox:<key>`, the `own` key set in `readPrior`, `adopted_from`). The file-name pattern in `readPrior` (`/^outbox-(.+?)(?:\.alt)?\.jsonl$/`) already accepts `~`; confirm it with a test.

K05 Tests (failing run first): a UUID-shaped id keeps its key unchanged; two ids that differ only in a disallowed character (for example `a/b` and `a:b`) get different keys and different files; two ids longer than 80 characters that share their first 80 characters get different keys; the empty id and an id named `unknown` get different keys; every key matches `/^[A-Za-z0-9_~-]{1,73}$/` and keys of the second form contain exactly one `~`; a session whose id has a disallowed character writes and reloads its own outbox file, and its file is found by `readPrior` from another session (the relay still works). All existing tests keep passing.

K06 Scope guard: only plugins/dopemux-memory-bridge/hooks/register.tsx and plugins/dopemux-memory-bridge/hooks/register.test.ts; only `safeId` and the new hash helper change in register.tsx. Report `git diff --numstat`.

K07 Gates: `claude plugin test plugins/dopemux-memory-bridge`, `claude plugin validate plugins/dopemux-memory-bridge`, `tsc -p` with an out-of-repo tsconfig on the Claude Code declaration the coordinator supplies (path and sha256 in your prompt).
